sources.summary: Five wealthy women set off for a weekend where everyone has something to hide. Plus: Dan Snow follows in Odysseus’s wake. Here’s what to watch this evening 9pm, Sky Atlantic This glossy drama about wealthy women who head off on a girls’ weekend is the perfect chaser for anyone who raced through Two Weeks in August . After her husband dies, celebrity cook Hollis Shaw (Jennifer Garner) organises a bougie trip with four friends: the school mom, the college bestie, the sort-of sister and the fan who reached out on social media. But everyone has a secret – and one is an absolute shocker. Gemma Chan, Chloë Sevigny, Regina Hall and D’Arcy Carden star. Hollie Richardson Continue reading...
